listing.name: GoldenEye 007 N64 PC Port
listing.summary: Explore GoldenEye 007 N64 PC Port and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare your own game
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official Windows archive. Create data beside ge007.x86_64.exe and copy your own US NTSC-U ROM there as ge007.ntsc-final.z64. Register ge007.x86_64.exe as the external player; prepare-assets/ge007-convert.exe is a setup helper, not the play target.

steps.title: Choose Play to finish upstream setup
steps.instruction: The first explicit Play generates asset sidecars from the verified ROM using the included upstream converter. Later starts reuse those files. Downloading and read-only discovery do not run the converter or the game.

steps.title: Update without carrying obsolete assets
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s update guide: extract a new version separately and copy only your ROM, data/ge007.eep and data/ge007.ini, retaining the old copy. Do not carry generated pcmodels-* or pccg-* folders; the new player must regenerate them. Keep any emulator save backup too. This version-dependent in-folder generation does not fit the current native-portable persistence contract. Runtime updates stay with you/upstream, and external data stays outside Portcove backups.
